site_name: Ground Floor Flat, 34 Pont Street, LONDON, SW1X 0AD
description: Internal alterations including infilling of double door aperture in stud wall and installation of single door aperture to the right hand side when entering kitchen (to become second bedroom); disconnection of waste and pipework to kitchen and installation of plumbing for new washing machine; new stud walls (plastered and painted) and double doors within drawing room to create small kitchen with new suspended ceiling; installation of plumbing to supply both water and waste to new kitchen; removal of door leading to drawing room and replacement with pocket door in line with the new stud wall forming the new kitchen; new cornice, skirting and architraves to match existing where required; replacement of wood flooring like for like where required; external alterations including preparation and re-painting of both wrought iron balustrade to balcony and French doors; and replacement of flooring to balcony (Listed Building Consent only)
